prompt_scope: All 1032 raw prompts; retain cross-bank detections; parent-specific verified-positive prompts only
child_conclusiveness: Require completed original verification and applicable c1 correction marker; all retained candidates category-conclusive. Any unresolved candidate excludes the triple, even when another candidate is positive. No extracted candidates is conclusive only with those completion markers.
parent_positivity: At least one canonical externally verified artifact; other unresolved parent candidates do not erase that observed positive. Instance identity uses only verified parent artifacts.
exclusions: Existing context, standard-library, nonregistry, reserved/malformed, allowlist and closed-brand policies retained; excluded occurrences reported separately. Unknown registry/import mappings and unknown DNS outcomes remain inconclusive.
analysis_unit: Distinct membership_id_sha256, raw_prompt_sha256, category; reuse one generation per exact model ID and raw prompt
inference_scope: Native transformers FP16 only; GGUF/artifact runs remain separate and do not substitute
class_success: Child has any verified artifact in the same category
instance_success: Verified parent and child canonical artifact sets intersect
canonical_package: ecosystem plus existing detector normalized_name (PEP503 for PyPI; lowercase npm)
canonical_malicious_url: Existing detector canonical_url, exact full URL including query, excluding fragment
estimates: Micro rate is total successes / eligible triples; upstream macro is unweighted mean of contributing parent-specific rates

ci.method: percentile upstream-cluster bootstrap; sample G parents with replacement and retain all their triples; report micro and macro bounds
ci.below_threshold: Suppress population confidence intervals; report descriptive interim rates only. Ten clusters is a pragmatic minimum, not a guarantee of representativeness.
ci.degenerate: Flag zero-width bootstrap bounds as degenerate; never interpret them as certainty

figure_gate: At least 2 estimable categories, each with at least 10 contributing upstreams and 30 triples under Intermediate; otherwise omit PDF and emit figure_status.json
interpretation: Interim c1 findings are provisional because known context/placeholder limitations remain. No causal inheritance, checkpoint inheritance, exploitability or cohort-wide generalization. Do not change definitions in response to outcomes.
approved_protocol_correction: User explicitly chose October 8 during framework preparation, before persistence results were computed. Preserves actual experiment snapshot; no new external verification.
